response.enhanced_information: Hypovolemia, characterized by decreased blood volume, significantly increases ADH secretion to conserve water and increase blood volume. Hypotension also triggers increased ADH secretion to help raise blood pressure. In contrast, hypervolemia and decreased osmolarity lead to decreased ADH secretion.
